# Test fixtures (tests only)

`overpass-kolkata-sample.json` is a small, unmodified excerpt of a real Overpass API
response for Kolkata, used **only** to test parsing and normalisation. It is never
loaded by the application.

Data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License (ODbL):
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright

Edge-case records (missing coordinates, duplicates, hostile URLs…) are written inline
in the test files and are clearly synthetic.
